en.bdb: The cheat lover is like elephant and colocynth,

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਦੀਆਂ ਨਾਲੇ ਵਾਹੜੇ ਗੰਗ ਸੰਗ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੰਗ ਹੁਵੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: nadheeaa(n) naale vaahaRe ga(n)g sa(n)g mil ga(n)g huva(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Rivers and streams become Ganges after meeting the latter.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਸੇਂਵਦੇ ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵਾ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: aThasaTh teerath se(n)vadhe dhevee dhevaa sev kara(n)dhe|

en.bdb: The cheats undertake to go at sixty-eight pilgrimage centres and serve gods and goddesses.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੋਕ ਵੇਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣ ਨਾਉ ਸੁਣੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: lok vedh gun giaan vich patit udhaaran naau suna(n)dhe|

en.bdb: They, from people during their discussions over good and knowledge, listen to the name of the Lord, the saviour of the fallen ones;

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਸਤੀ ਨੀਰਿ ਨ੍ਹਵਾਲੀਅਨਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਲਿ ਛਾਰੁ ਛਣੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: hasatee neer nhavaaleean baahar nikal chhaar chhana(n)dhe|

en.bdb: But, it is like the elephant who is bathed in water but coming out of it spreads dusts all round.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਨ ਚਿਤਿ ਧਰੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh sun gur upadhes na chit dhara(n)dhe|

en.bdb: The cheats listen to the teachings of the Guru in the holy congregation but do not adopt them in the mind.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੁੰਮੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਿੰਜੀਐ ਬੀਜੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲ ਨ ਫਲੰਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: tu(n)me a(n)mirat si(n)jeeaai beejai a(n)mirat fal na fala(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Even if irrigated by nectar, the seeds of colocynth never become sweet,
The cheating lovers never follow the straight path i.e. they do not follow the way of truth.
